insights.title: Price spread
insights.text: The catalogue runs from ₹99 to ₹1,799, a 18.2× range. The most expensive listing is Lavish Lavender Jewellery Gift Box for Her.

insights.title: Evenly distributed pricing
insights.text: Mean ₹766 and median ₹799 land within 4% of each other, so there is no strong skew.

insights.title: One discount dominates
insights.text: 11 of 20 products (55%) carry exactly 50% off. That is a blanket store-wide rule rather than per-product pricing, which limits what discount analysis can reveal.

insights.title: Savings are concentrated
insights.text: The top 6 products (30% of the range) account for half of all ₹11,094 in savings. Red HeartBeat Gift Box alone contributes ₹1,500.

insights.title: Blended discount
insights.text: ₹11,094 comes off ₹26,414 of original value — an effective 42.0% discount. That is a normal promotional range.

insights.title: Charm pricing is the house style
insights.text: 12 of 20 prices end in 99 (60%). Pricing is set by psychological anchor, so price is a weak proxy for product value here.

insights.title: Title sentiment
insights.text: 7 positive, 10 neutral, 3 negative across 20 product titles. Titles are descriptive rather than evaluative, so treat this as a text-processing demonstration, not a customer signal.

insights.title: Deepest value
